description: The British Geological Survey compiles the World Mineral Statistics dataset, which is continuous from 1913 and underlies the annual publication World Mineral Production. The latest edition covers the five years 2020 to 2024 for more than 70 mineral commodities by country worldwide, with an appendix on European production of aggregates and cement and a treemap of 2024 metal and ore output. Figures are compiled from home and overseas government departments, national statistical offices, commodity authorities, company reports and a network of contacts, to serve security of supply, economic, environmental and policy analyses. Access is free: the annual PDF publication, an online data download tool with an API, one-off reports, and an archive of every previous edition back to Mineral Statistics of the British Empire and Foreign Countries (1913 to 1947), which also holds import and export data for much of the last century; printed editions can be bought. The licence is not stated on the page. Caveats: values are national annual totals, sources vary in reliability, and import and export series are not complete for recent years. For simulation it provides long country production series for supply-chain concentration, capacity planning and resilience analysis of mineral inputs to industry. Related catalogue records include World Mining Data and the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries.
